gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.676468 45.514045)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.676468 45.514045)',4326)::geography,
        3000
      )
  AND amenity = 'fast_food';

distance_result AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Distance(cafe_geom.geom, restaurant_geom.geom) / 1000 AS distance_km
  FROM 
    cafe_geom, restaurant_geom
),
clip_area AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(cafe_geom.geom, 3000) AS geom
  FROM 
    cafe_geom
),
elevation_result AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(r.rast, 1, ST_Centroid(clip_area.geom)) AS elevation
  FROM 
    clip_area,
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast::geography, clip_area.geom)
)
SELECT 
  distance_result.distance_km AS distance_km,
  elevation_result.elevation AS elevation_meters
FROM 
  distance_result, elevation_result;
